name: aide-web-typescript
description: Native TypeScript sources and generated JavaScript runtime for the embedded Aide UI and host bridges; no bundler, no framework.

scripts.typecheck: npm run check:ts-sources && tsc -p internal/server/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p internal/server/web/tsconfig.worklets.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.computer-bridge.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.computer-bridge-linux.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.headless-browser-bridge.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.safari-bridge.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.standalone-browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.standalone-node.json --noEmit
scripts.build:ts: npm run check:ts-sources && tsc -p internal/server/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p internal/server/web/tsconfig.worklets.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.computer-bridge.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.computer-bridge-linux.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.headless-browser-bridge.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.safari-bridge.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.standalone-browser.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.standalone-node.json && node scripts/finalize-standalone-output.cjs
